data.name: Vedantashree
data.gender_notes: Vedantashree is used as a unisex name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Vedantashree is derived from Vedanta, meaning 'knowledge, wisdom'. It is a name for a goddess or a wise, knowledgeable woman. The name carries the spiritual significance of seeking knowledge and understanding of the universe and the self. The name Vedantashree carries the meaning “Knowledge, wisdom, goddess” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Vedantashree usually hope their child will grow to embody knowledge, wisdom, goddess and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbolizes the pursuit of knowledge and wisdom in the spiritual journey.
data.etymology: Vedantashree belongs to the Sanskrit linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Knowledge, wisdom, goddess.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Vedantashree total 5, giving a life-path number of 5. Number 5 is linked with Mercury and with the qualities of freedom, adaptability and curiosity.

vedic_reference.note: Vedanta is a philosophical tradition and a branch of Hinduism based on the Upanishads and the Bhagavad Gita.

historical_references.reference: Vedanta Desika (14th century CE), a prominent scholar, philosopher and poet in the Bhagavatam tradition of the Hindu religion, who contributed significantly to the development of the Vedanta philosophy through his works like 'Nyayasudha' and 'Vedarthasamgraha'. He was revered as 'Vedantashree'.

Swami Vivekananda (19th century CE), a renowned monk, scholar and chief disciple of Ramakrishna Paramahamsa, who played a pivotal role in spreading the message of Vedanta philosophy to the western world through international conferences and his writings. He was also revered as 'Vedantashree'.

modern_usage.modern_context: In today's digital age, the name 'Vedantashree' carries a modern context in the spirituality, self-help, and wellness communities. It is often seen on LinkedIn profiles of individuals who have a deep interest or practice in Vedanta, a Hindu philosophical tradition. On Facebook, there are numerous groups dedicated to Vedanta and its teachings, and 'Vedantashree' might be a title of respect given to a group administrator or a notable figure. Lastly, on Instagram, you may find influencers or motivational speakers using this title in their bio or as a hashtag to connect with their followers in the spiritual and self-help niches.
